# Keeret Mahi

> Keeret Mahi is a Computer Science and Business student exploring the intersection of software, design, artificial intelligence, hardware, and business.

This file is the machine-readable index for Keeret Mahi's portfolio. The linked Markdown files contain the same factual content as the interactive website without requiring JavaScript.

## Core pages

- [About Keeret Mahi](https://keeretmahi.com/content/about.md): Background, education, current work, interests, and contact links.
- [Projects](https://keeretmahi.com/content/projects/index.md): Index of selected software and hardware projects.
- [Experience and education](https://keeretmahi.com/content/experience.md): Professional experience, leadership, and university education.
- [Resume](https://keeretmahi.com/content/resume.md): Accessible resume overview and link to the original PDF.
- [Gallery](https://keeretmahi.com/content/gallery.md): Milestones including valedictorian, DECA, graduation, and case competitions.

## Project case studies

- [gooseCalendar](https://keeretmahi.com/content/projects/goose-calendar.md): A web app that parses course outlines into reviewable calendar events using deterministic parsing, AI-assisted extraction, caching, validation, and calendar export.
- [GCode Plotter](https://keeretmahi.com/content/projects/cnc-plotter.md): A hardware project that converts SVG artwork into GCode and coordinated pen motion using GRBL, an Arduino Uno, stepper motors, and a micro servo.
